{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders
completed_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = completed_orders['revenue'].mean()

# Confirm no internal QA or refunded orders are included
qa_orders = completed_orders[completed_orders['revenue'] == 999999.99]
refunded_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'refunded']

print(f'Number of QA orders in completed: {len(qa_orders)}')
print(f'Number of refunded orders: {len(refunded_orders)}')
print(f'Mean revenue (completed): {mean_revenue}')"}
